stem: $M$ is the centre of a circle of radius ${=r}$ cm. $\overleftrightarrow{AB}$ is a tangent to the circle at $A$ and $AB = {=t}$ cm. $AC$ is a chord of the circle and $D$ is its midpoint, with $MD = {=d}$ cm. Find the perimeter of the figure $ABMD$ in cm.
solution: $MA$ is a radius, $MA = {=r}$ cm, and $\overleftrightarrow{AB}$ is a tangent, so $MA \perp AB$ and triangle $MAB$ has a right angle at $A$.
$D$ is the midpoint of the chord $AC$, so $MD \perp AC$ and triangle $MDA$ has a right angle at $D$.
Perimeter of $ABMD = AB + BM + MD + DA = {=t} + {=mb} + {=d} + {=h} = {=t + mb + d + h}$ cm.
notes: Advanced: two right triangles (tangent-radius, then chord midpoint-perpendicular), as in book 4-f. Triples are scaled 3-4-5 and 5-12-13, so all lengths are whole numbers. Self-contained stem, no figure needed.
